archetypes.name: dyn-era-boundary
archetypes.rationale: Auto-boundary lookup has multiple one-fetch and wrong-repo failure modes.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the voter-calibration era boundary code. Verify plugin-root repo resolution never falls back to consumer cwd or unscoped gh repo view. Check the single gh issue view payload includes number and is passed to the shipped predicate with repo=None. Confirm missing git, missing gh, malformed JSON, unshipped issue, and missing closedAt all render boundary-unavailable guidance without traceback. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-era-bucketing
archetypes.rationale: Run-dir bucketing and repeated headings drive the operator-facing comparison.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review era corpus collection and rendering. Confirm _ground_truth_run_dir and strict started_at are used for every TSV, boundary equality goes to post, unsupported dated files still count in the relevant slice, and missing started_at runs are excluded once. Check that every emitted era slice contains the exact pinned Agreement Table and Voter Severity Scoreboard headings. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-era-harness
archetypes.rationale: The shell harness stubs git and gh to pin subtle degradation behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the voter-calibration shell harness additions. Verify the fake git and gh tests actually exercise FileNotFoundError and single-fetch success paths, keep CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT import bootstrapping viable via the python symlink, and assert no gh fetch when repo resolution fails. Check that no default-mode assertions became weaker. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
